description_en: Queries a list of database accounts that the current Resource Access Management (RAM) user is authorized to manage
description_zh: 获取当前RAM用户已授权的数据库账户列表
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost list-operation-database-accounts --instance-id bastionhost-cn-2r42t9cvf0i --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListOperationDatabaseAccounts

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the bastion host.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query the ID of the bastion host
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机实例的ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host.

For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的地域ID。
地域ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The database ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2758856.html operation to query the database ID
parameters.help_zh:
数据库实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2758856.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: database_id

parameters.help_zh: 指定分页查询时，当前页的页码。默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page.
Maximum value: 100. Default value: 20. If you leave this parameter empty, 20 entries are returned on each page. We recommend that you do not leave this parameter empty
parameters.help_zh:
指定分页查询时，每页显示的数据最大条数。
PageSize参数最大取值为100。每页默认显示的数据条数为20条，PageSize参数值为空时，将默认返回20条数据。 建议PageSize取值不要为空
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The name of the database account. Exact match is supported
parameters.help_zh: 数据库账号名称。精确匹配
parameters.name: database_account_name

DatabaseAccounts.description_zh: 查询到的数据库账户列表

DBName.description_en: The name of the PostgreSQL or Oracle database

DatabaseAccountName.description_en: The name of the database account

HasPassword.description_en: Indicates whether a password is configured for the database host account
HasPassword.description_zh: 数据库主机账户是否设置密码

LoginAttribute.description_en:
The logon attribute. One of the following values is returned if the database engine is Oracle:

SERVICENAME

SID
LoginAttribute.description_zh:
登录属性，Oracle类型数据库有返回值：

SERVICENAME
SID

ProtocolName.description_en: The protocol that is used by the database account
ProtocolName.description_zh: 数据库账户的协议名称

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
TotalCount.description_zh: 查询到的可运维数据库账户总数量
